"""Read-only comparison of preserved sealing capture, original files and source archive."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,tarfile
root=Path.cwd();sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def need(condition,message):
    if not condition:raise AssertionError(message)
summary_path=root/'reports/m2/stage23-final-summary.json';summary=read(summary_path)
need(summary['implementation_commit']=='84d7044e7b9b83350b895a3b91a92663aedb73df','unexpected implementation')
archive_row=summary['archives']['source'];archive=root/archive_row['path']
need(sha(archive)==archive_row['sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size==archive_row['bytes'],'source archive identity')
origin_path=root/'target/m2/stage23-readiness-captured-exploration-seal-01/COPY_ORIGIN.json';origin=read(origin_path)
need(len(origin['files'])==4,'sealing capture closure changed')
prefix='helper-history/stage23-readiness-captured-exploration-seal-01/'
rows=[]
with tarfile.open(archive) as stream:
    members=stream.getmembers();lookup={member.name:member for member in members}
    need(len(lookup)==len(members),'duplicate archive member')
    inventory=json.load(stream.extractfile(lookup['EVIDENCE.json']));inventory_rows={row['path']:row for row in inventory['files']}
    need(stream.extractfile(lookup[prefix+'COPY_ORIGIN.json']).read()==origin_path.read_bytes(),'archived preservation manifest changed')
    expected_members={prefix+'COPY_ORIGIN.json'}
    for row in origin['files']:
        original=root/row['original_path'];copied=root/row['copied_path'];data=original.read_bytes()
        need(copied.read_bytes()==data,'original/copied raw bytes differ')
        need(len(data)==row['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],'raw preservation identity differs')
        member=prefix+copied.name;expected_members.add(member)
        need(stream.extractfile(lookup[member]).read()==data,'archived sealing capture differs from original')
        need(inventory_rows[member]['sha256']==row['sha256'] and inventory_rows[member]['bytes']==row['bytes'],'archived inventory identity differs')
        rows.append(dict(original_path=row['original_path'],copied_path=row['copied_path'],archive_member=member,sha256=row['sha256'],bytes=row['bytes'],all_three_payloads_identical=True))
    need({name for name in lookup if name.startswith(prefix)}==expected_members,'extra or missing preserved capture files')
original_process=root/'target/m2/stage23-seal-command-01/process.json';process=read(original_process)
need(process['exit_code']==0 and not process['timed_out'],'original sealing process failed')
for channel in ['stdout','stderr']:
    path=original_process.parent/(channel+'.bin');need(sha(path)==process[channel+'_sha256'] and path.stat().st_size==process[channel+'_bytes'],'original sealing process raw channel differs')
report=dict(status='pass',utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),scope='Independent read-only original/copy/archive byte comparison for the completed exploration sealing outer capture. This verifies preservation without re-executing the sealer or any retained helper/evaluator.',
    implementation_commit=summary['implementation_commit'],summary=dict(path=str(summary_path.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(summary_path)),source_archive=archive_row,
    copy_manifest=dict(path=str(origin_path.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(origin_path)),preserved_files=rows,original_process=dict(path=str(original_process.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(original_process),command=process['command'],exit_code=0,raw_channels_verified=True),
    original_paths_and_commands_unchanged=True,preservation_is_a_second_execution=False,captured_artifacts_executed=False,
    reviewer=dict(path=str(Path(__file__).relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),source_utf8=Path(__file__).read_text()))
out=root/'reports/m2/stage23-sealing-capture-audit.json'
with out.open('x') as stream:json.dump(report,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='pass',files=4,path=str(out.relative_to(root)),sha256=sha(out)),indent=2))
